description: The native clickhouse-go driver appends a Map column only from a map of exactly the Go types it reads the column as, so a copyfrom or a batch of lone placeholders appending a Map whose values hold an IP address (net.IP, *net.IP, []net.IP where the generated code holds netip.Addr, *netip.Addr, []netip.Addr) or a named tuple (map[string]any where the generated code holds a struct), at any depth, through an Array of maps or a named Tuple holding one, hands it over through the generated sglAppendNativeValue, which converts the value into the driver's forms. An IPv4 address appended to an IPv6 Map value reads back IPv4-mapped and an IPv4-mapped one appended to an IPv4 Map value reads back as IPv4, as the driver appends a netip.Addr; a nil pointer is NULL; an empty or nil map is empty. Maps of 128- and 256-bit integers, keyed by them, of nullable ones and of arrays of them, and maps of unnamed tuples holding an address, append as they are.
